messages:
Maya (CS): ok team — we need to batch the hands-on kickoff clinic for Cohort Gamma. goal: get 20 customers through the lab over 2 weeks, with at least 1 APAC-friendly slot. ideas?
Jon (Solutions): +1. thinking 2x 90m sessions per week (one Americas, one EMEA/APAC). keeps lab size manageable.
Priya (Onboarding): I can run a 4-option poll for dates/times. prefer mornings PST for Americas, late mornings UTC for EMEA, and 7am PST for APAC overlap. will add a timezone note.
Liam (Scheduling): capacity question — how many hands-on seats per session? we can't exceed the infra sandbox limits.
Olivia (Facilitator): I can host up to 12 hands-on seats. beyond that we switch to watch-and-learn + breakout QA. agenda I propose: 1) 15m quick setup, 2) 50m guided lab, 3) 20m troubleshooting + Q&A, 4) 5m wrap & survey.
Maya (CS): perfect. so plan = 6 sessions across 2 weeks (12 seats each) = 72 seats total, give or take. prioritize renewal-risk accounts for hands-on seats.
Jon (Solutions): note: we've got a Dedicated migration workshop the afternoon of the 8th — avoid that window for facilitators.
Priya (Onboarding): poll created: https://doodle.fake/rdw-kickoff-gamma (4 options). please review. I'll tag accounts for priority invites after we lock slots.
calendar-bot: poll created by Priya (Onboarding): https://doodle.fake/rdw-kickoff-gamma
Liam (Scheduling): ok, set seats = 12 hands-on / session. collect prework link and ask for OS, model workloads, and preferred IDE so we can pre-provision.
Olivia (Facilitator): prework checklist snippet for labs: `1) add ssh key to console 2) confirm docker installed 3) read quickstart.md` — I'll add to the invite.
Maya (CS): tagging @Olivia (Facilitator) as lead, @Jon (Solutions) as backup. Priya will send invites & priority slots. :thumbsup:
Jon (Solutions): I'll take session #3 backup. also suggest we color-code calendar invites for priority customers (red) so success managers can triage.
Priya (Onboarding): quick ask — do we want recording + slides + an anonymized transcript posted to the onboarding repo?
Olivia (Facilitator): yes — recordings + a short survey. add this survey link to the wrap: https://forms.fake/rdw-kickoff-feedback
Liam (Scheduling): FYI I'll create calendar blocks for facilitators the week prior for dry runs (30m each).
Maya (CS): great. Priya — please copy the canonical prework + survey links in the invite, and I'll send the priority list by EOD.
Priya (Onboarding): will do. Draft invite after poll closes, sharing the invite text here for quick review.
Maya (CS): thanks all — final note: capture any onboarding blockers in the ticket (CS-3281) so we can follow up post-session.
Jon (Solutions): noted.
Olivia (Facilitator): ready to host.
Priya (Onboarding): poll closes tomorrow noon PT — I'll post final slots and send invites after.
Maya (CS): awesome — closing out.
